The '''''TurboDyne'' 99''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Podracer [[Kidd Kareen]] owned such a pod, which he lent to fellow racer and crush [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] for during the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Speedway]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] hinted that a stock 99 was better than a stock [[Solarix-G6]].
